_doc: Fresh-context audit verdicts (data-fabrication-auditor, Sonnet, 2026-10-10) for South India. Taxi loads ONLY with KEEP/CORRECT. Food: every food figure with a tier was audited, so unaudited food is skipped. A CORRECT food verdict with standard null is budget-only, and the loader skips it.
